blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Veteran setter Mars Alba is eager to make the most of Akari’s talent by orchestrating a balanced offense in the PVL All-Filipino Conference Siklab Series. Alba dished out 22 excellent sets and scored eight points in Akari’s second straight win of the tournament, outlasting Farm Fresh, 25-22, 25-27, 22-25, 25-23, 15-12, last Tuesday at Ninoy Aquino Stadium. The Alas Pilipinas setter stressed the importance of collective effort and trust in their previous wins to improve to a 2-2 record after a flat start. “I think it’s very important to keep pushing everyone and reminding the players that each […]...
